One shared body budget and a component ledger replace overlapping granular reactions; hard terrain remains Rapier-owned.
A new opt-in versioned value protocol must carry moments; unchanged legacy11/9 and frozen aggregate proxy results are not a validated new torque law.

66 paired Y1/GCR cases plus separate negative/state/async/capacity controls, all-nine category coverage, analytical torque/energy tests and source-bound owner review.
